column1: # - Runtime ownership policy for the VM-first 0.0.7 line.
# - Expands these prefix rules over every real std module so new modules cannot
#   silently enter the release without an explicit VM/native/target ownership

column4: notes
Binary descriptor values are inert compiler/VM-owned protocol contracts.
Portable collection values must remain VM-owned values.
Core language values and traits must remain VM-owned portable contracts.
Structured data helpers are Rust-owned NativeBoundary capabilities.
Database APIs are Rust-owned NativeBoundary capabilities.
Encoding APIs use maintained Rust crates through NativeBoundary.
Hyper/http/rustls-backed web APIs are runtime capabilities.
Host IO is a NativeBoundary capability.
Generated JavaScript and DOM bindings are JS-target surfaces.
Logging is a host/runtime capability.
Explicit native modules expose resource handles through NativeBoundary.
Network parsing helpers use maintained Rust crates.
Random generation uses maintained Rust crates while generator state remains explicit.
Finite range values are portable VM-owned data contracts.
Regex compilation and matching use maintained Rust crates through NativeBoundary.
Sync/resource abstractions are VM-owned runtime contracts.
Template values are compiler/VM-owned data contracts.
Test assertions are tooling-owned release support.
Time value types are portable millisecond records with JS-compatible numeric payloads.
VM process/runtime modules are source-facing VM contracts.
WebAssembly ABI aliases are target-surface contracts for wasm.core lowering.
